messages:
ajay_sales: Quick sync — Meridian Health wants a POC perf run. Goal: 8k sustained QPS (app-level), ~3 model calls per request, p99 end-to-end <250ms, burst to 12k for 5m. They asked for Dedicated pricing estimate + security checklist answers. Can we confirm a load plan and any enterprise blockers?

maria_dev: Ack. Need a few more inputs: avg prompt tokens per call, max seq len, and % of calls that hit KV cache. If we assume 256 tokens and 70% cache hit, rough capacity estimate = 4 x p4d for steady state with conservative batching.

gabe_se: @maria_dev they’ll send prompt distro in an hour. Also they require KMS + customer-managed keys and multi-AZ failover. Security team flagged egress rules for their VPC.

emily_sre: Note on multi-AZ — Dedicated supports active/standby across AZs but cross-AZ tail latency increases. For p99 <250ms we should keep most traffic in single AZ and rely on failover for outages. Ops runbook needed for AZ failover.

ajay_sales: Ok — actionable items: (1) load plan + runbook (2) cost estimate for Dedicated + burst buffer (3) security Qs list for Meridian. Who takes which?

maria_dev: I’ll draft the load plan and runbook. Early sketch below.

maria_dev: ```
load_generator: vegeta-like
profile:
  - name: steady
    qps: 8000
    duration: 45m
  - name: burst
    qps: 12000
    duration: 5m
concurrency_per_request: 3
prompt_tokens_avg: 256
cache_behaviour:
  kv_hit: 0.7
  prefix_cache_enabled: true
metrics:
  - p50,p90,p95,p99,tail_ops,token_cost
notes: capture model-internal latency and network e2e separately
```

gabe_se: Nice. For pricing: recommend reserved 4x p4d baseline + burst pool (on-demand spare nodes) — estimate monthly commit ~$120k + burst OPEX ~15k for test month. I’ll compute exact per-token numbers after Maria confirms actual token counts.

ajay_sales: Good. Security questions: KMS yes, SOC2 report available? Also they want a data residency attestation for EU region if we spin Dedicated there.

emily_sre: SOC2 type II report is available — I’ll attach link in the external doc. For KMS: we can support customer-managed keys in Dedicated and Private. Need Meridian’s KMS key ARN + cross-account IAM role for access.

gabe_se: Also note enterprise blocker: their procurement wants SLA for p99 latency. We don’t guarantee p99 latency under multi-AZ failover or during massive infrastructure failures. Need to craft wording: SLA covers uptime and median latency targets; tail latency is best-effort and we provide observability/alerts.

ajay_sales: Understood — will flag to legal. Maria, Emily — any test env constraints? We should avoid touching prod Dedicated pools.

maria_dev: We’ll run the POC in a staging Dedicated environment with isolated GPU pool. Run plan: smoke tests (10m), ramp to 8k over 15m, steady 45m, 3x burst samples, soak 1h. Collect token billing, model latency, and p99. I’ll include health checks and fallback policy (route to smaller model variant if p99 > 600ms).

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Starting staged Dedicated cluster (staging-dedicated-2026-03) — estimated provisioning 12m. [provision-id: stg-7891]

emily_sre: Add network note: ensure VPC peering & egress allowlist for loadgen IPs and KMS endpoints. We also need to validate HSM/KMS latency — it can add ~10-30ms per key operation.

gabe_se: Also flag: Meridian uses an L7 proxy that can re-order small requests. Ask them to disable request coalescing for the test window or we'll see extra jitter.

ajay_sales: Great — next steps: Maria will post the finalized load plan + artifacts. Gabe will produce pricing matrix and per-token estimate. Emily will attach SOC2 + KMS guidance. I’ll consolidate for the customer-facing doc and procurement. Target: send to Meridian by EOD tomorrow.

maria_dev: Will post updated runbook and a short run checklist in this thread in ~2 hours.

ajay_sales: Thanks — one more ask: can we capture sample traces for a subset (1%) so engineering can isolate model vs infra tail?

maria_dev: Yep — adding tracing flag and sampling config to the plan.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Staged cluster ready — stg-7891 is live. Run ID: run-2026-03-22-01

emily_sre: I’ll start SOC2/KMS doc upload to shared drive and paste links here when done.

gabe_se: On pricing — preliminary scrub: committed baseline 4x p4d = $118,400/mo; burst buffer (preemptible or on-demand) for peak windows ~12% additional cost during test month. Final numbers after token distro.

ajay_sales: Perfect. If anything changes ping me in thread. :thumbsup:
